newsitem.title: MEXICO: Hong Kong's VTech to set up Mexico plant.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong's VTech to set up Mexico plant.

text.p: Hong Kong electronics firm VTech Holdings Ltd plans to set up a plant in western Mexico to make telephones and electronic games, the Jalisco state government said Monday.
In a statement, the government said Vtech will invest almost $2 million in the plant and create 150 new direct jobs. Guadalajara is the state capital of Jalisco.

It said the Mexican plant would supply product to the North and South American markets, which are now supplied by plants in Hong Kong and China. The state government gave no indication when the plant might be built and in operation.
